children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Follow API and operator output separately, preserve raw evidence, and correlate platform errors with events and audit.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Download raw records before restarting a component or changing the stream filter.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: API and operator logs describe different layers and must remain distinguishable during triage.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: API covers sessions, HTTP, database, streams, rate limits, integrations.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Operator covers reconciliation, workloads, modules, backups, Kubernetes.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Tail enough history; stop Follow before changing filters or components.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use timestamp, level, path, resource, status, and latency together, preserving multiline JSON exactly.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Do not search only for ERROR; retain the surrounding causal records.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Download before restart and record cluster, namespace, pod, timezone.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Redact Secrets and player data from shared excerpts.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Join API request/audit evidence to operator reconciliation, conditions, events, agent output, and the earliest error.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Tail enough history, Follow live, Download before restart

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Correlate time + actor + UID across audit, events, operator, game
